title: galium angustifolium

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Galium angustifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in natural medicine.
